The '''Battle of Thalina''' was fought between [[Protas]] and [[Melkorr]]. It took place at [[Thalina]].<ref name="Tale" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Thalina appeared in the short story "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod", written by [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] and published in [[2005]] in [[Prima Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando: Prima Official Game Guide]]''.<ref name="Tale" />
